fields.definition: A compact byte header encoding the arity and `.NET` `ShardKeyType` of a `ShardKey`'s record-id and child-id components, embedded at the front of every serialized representation (binary, UTF-8, and external string). Deserialization validates this header against the target generic type arguments so bytes produced for one key shape cannot be decoded as an incompatible key type, and `GhostShardKey` uses it to reconstruct and display keys whose generic types are not known at compile time. It identifies key component types rather than specific database tables.
fields.name: Shard key type metadata
